reference_note: mg-bodylab과 동일한 레퍼런스 13장(SHA 대조 확인)을 주제를 알고 다시 역설계한 변형. 서체·팔레트·재질·배경은 관찰값 그대로, 샘플 문자열과 샘플 소재만 시리즈 주제(기미·비타민C 앰플·스피큘·순한 스킨레이어)에 맞춰 작성했다.
surface: seamless sky-blue studio cyclorama with a soft vertical gradient, no horizon or corners
type_specimen: H1 sample "WHY MELASMA APPEARS" in heavy rounded sans caps with a thick dark outline; a caption sample "vitamin C" in the same face, smaller, pinned to the lower third
color_rules: Cyclorama Blue is background only and never touches a subject; Caption White is type only; skin tones carry the midground
components: a smooth-skinned 3D figure, centred to camera
a skin macro with pores and vellus hairs
a smooth simplified cutaway of skin layers
hands entering frame to hold a prop
a glass ampoule of golden fluid at real scale
a heavy white caption block with a dark outline
construction_logic: soft-lit 3D renders, smooth subsurface skin, rounded simplified anatomy, shallow macro depth of field
mini_scenes: a woman's face with soft melasma patches, caption across the lower third
golden oval needle-like spicules standing among skin pores
a smooth skin cutaway with golden droplets sinking through
motion_signature: slow push-in on a reacting face
macro drift across a skin surface
a cutaway peels open to the layer beneath
an ampoule drops in and settles
stage: the persistent background world every clip lives on - a seamless sky-blue cyclorama, softly graded, evenly lit, empty and ready for figures and props to enter

confidence.palette: high — extract_palette.py 실측 (동일 파일이므로 mg-bodylab 값 재사용)
